query:
SELECT id AS "id!",
  created_at AS "created_at!",
  updated_at AS "updated_at!",
  user_id AS "user_id!",
  course_id AS "course_id!",
  status AS "status!",
  expires_at AS "expires_at!",
  published_at,
  revision AS "revision!"
FROM (
    (
      SELECT id,
        created_at,
        updated_at,
        user_id,
        course_id,
        agent_changeset_current_status(status, expires_at) AS status,
        expires_at,
        published_at,
        revision
      FROM agent_changesets
      WHERE user_id = $1
        AND course_id = ANY($2)
        AND agent_changeset_is_open(status, expires_at)
    )
    UNION ALL
    (
      SELECT id,
        created_at,
        updated_at,
        user_id,
        course_id,
        agent_changeset_current_status(status, expires_at) AS status,
        expires_at,
        published_at,
        revision
      FROM agent_changesets
      WHERE user_id = $1
        AND course_id = ANY($2)
        AND NOT agent_changeset_is_open(status, expires_at)
      ORDER BY created_at DESC,
        id
      LIMIT $3
    )
  ) listed
ORDER BY created_at DESC,
  id
